dk_elder: I drill the newly risen. You woke in a grave with no memory of dying - so did everyone standing in this valley. This is Deathknell, and you are Forsaken now. It gets easier. I can make it get easier faster.
dk_risen: I don't - I don't remember my name yet. They said to give it time. I came up out of the grave field just there, and the others in it are still coming up, and they are not all coming up right.
dk_quest_overseer: Krell, overseer of Deathknell. Every one of us starts here: a body, a grave, and a grudge against whoever put us in it. I decide what you do with yours until you're fit to be sent on to Brill. I've got work.
dk_foreman_gresk: Gresk. I was foreman of this goldmine claim when I was alive, and I've seen no reason to stop. Don't touch the shaft. Don't touch my crew. Don't touch the spiders. Actually - do touch the spiders.
dk_mourner_isolde: Isolde. I keep the vigil at the Weeping Pond, just west of where I'm sitting. The ones who drowned in it don't rest, and they've taken things off the bank that belonged to people I loved.
dk_gardener_orrel: Orrel. This was my farm - the burned one, behind me. Nothing grows here now. I plant anyway. Somebody has to believe in tomorrow, and the scarecrows I built have stopped being any help.
dk_scout_verrick: Verrick, scout for the Deathguard. Keep your voice down. The Scarlet Crusade holds the crypt just north-east of us, and they have good ears, short tempers, and a great deal of lamp oil.
dk_sexton_marrow: Marrow, sexton of the Shadow Grave - the crypt-yard behind me. Every soul deserves a proper burial. Even the ones that won't stay in it. Especially those.
ct_deathknell: Verity. I train every discipline for Deathknell - what you were in life decides less than you'd think. Show me what you've managed so far, and bring coin.
pt_deathknell_forge: Veyra. I teach mining here - where to dig, and how to tell ore from rock. Deathknell has no forge. For smithing, ask at the one in Brill, down the road east.
pt_deathknell_herbs: Aldous, apothecary. I teach herbalism: which plant to pull and which to leave. Brewing is the other half, and Brill has the bench for it - Apothecary Bleak teaches alchemy there.
pt_deathknell_wood: I teach woodcutting. Fell it clean and strip it properly; a log cut badly is a log cut twice. The sawmill is south-west of me, by the lower graves. Woodworking itself is taught in Brill.
